text_block_list.name: Underling
text_block_list.text:
"Pokke-san, please help us!
The team we beat earlier is picking a fight with us...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Tell me the location, I'm heading over now. Don't let them do anything stupid before I get there, got it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: For now, I'm just glad you're safe. You really had me worried.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry...
I promise I'll make this up to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Jungle Pocket apologized for skipping training without notice. Seeing her genuine remorse, I warned her to be more careful from now on.
